problem_type: Standalone document gestures omit an undo journal boundary
symptom: Changing edge mode, disconnecting an edge, or toggling a node lock makes Cmd+Z remove the preceding unrelated edit.
direct_cause: These store actions append replayable events without a preceding pushUndoSnapshot; disconnectEdge previously only opened a barrier for parameter scope.
class_root: Standalone document actions must establish their own journal boundary; event emission by itself does not establish history ownership.
affected_population: Canvas users editing edge modes, disconnecting manual/group connections, or locking/unlocking nodes
internal_only_reason: This is the internal store/journal gesture contract, not third-party React Flow behavior; no library API changes.
invariants: Every confirmed standalone mutation opens one barrier before its first event, after no-op guards.
Nested proposal writes continue to use the outer transaction barrier.
generality_proof: All callers of the three actions converge in the store; default/parameter/group disconnection share the same guarded boundary, and both lock directions share setNodeLocked. Existing pushUndoSnapshot honors proposal suppression.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Guard and establish history for edge-mode and disconnection mutations.
Guard and establish history for lock/unlock mutations.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Real edge menu invokes it directly; newly added failing test verifies previous node survives undo.
Default edge menu omitted the parameter-only boundary; shared default/group/parameter path now owns one.
NodeLockBadge invokes it directly; newly added failing test verifies lock undo without removing previous node.
Continuous movement uses captureHistory at useCanvasSelectionDrag gesture start; adding a per-frame barrier would split one drag.
createFrame delegates createGroup; setGroupDescription already guards and opens one barrier.

recurrence.reason: Three independent user actions reproduce the same skipped-boundary failure for every subsequent use.
same_class_scan: Read all action implementations in canvasGraphActions.ts, canvasNodeActions.ts, canvasFrameStoreActions.ts, canvasGroupMoveActions.ts; inventory in companion Markdown.
rg connectNodes/disconnectEdge/setNodeLocked/reassignNodeCategory/captureHistory across src; read edge menu, NodeLockBadge, drag start, proposalTxn and category deletion callers.

prevention.invariant: Standalone guarded store mutations establish history before journal events.
prevention.failure_mode: Missing IDs and unchanged values return without creating an empty undo step.
prevention.strategy: Repair existing store action ownership, keeping proposal grouping in the existing journal suppression mechanism; no caller-side history patch.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove the parameter-only history conditional in disconnectEdge; retain one shared boundary and no fallback implementation.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Internal journal semantics; React Flow and Zustand remain unchanged.

migration: No persisted schema changes. Existing documents use the repaired action boundaries for subsequent edits; history remains session-local.
residual_risks: Composite connectNodes mention insertion and cross-store category deletion need separate ownership work; see companion scan.
React Flow multi-edge callback loops over disconnectEdge; multi-selection gesture grouping is outside the explicit no-reactFlow-change scope.

invariant_owner_layer.why: Standalone action semantics live in the store, where UI and agent callers converge; journal supplies the existing suppression mechanism.
